t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The mushroom yield cycles, irrespective of gnome colour or shape. you should experiment at first with colours and shapes, and if one has a low yield, try another

vb_textbox.text: There seems to be no consistency with colours of gnome (e.g. a red gnome might score highly at one point, then much worse at another). i also didn't spot a pattern in shape of gnome. First I experimented a bit, and then I continuously chose the gnome on the right. once the yield was lower than the round before, I switched to the left gnome. again, once yield was lower than the round before, I switched back to right and vice versa. aside from this I struggled to find patterns!
